top_signals.title: Arkansas truck blitz nets 183 English violations, 44 arrests in 48 hours
top_signals.summary:
A two-day Arkansas trucking enforcement blitz resulted in 183 English-language proficiency violations, 44 criminal arrests and 74 immigration violations.

top_signals.summary: Wall Street got a reality check as a bruising selloff in technology shares fueled concern the artificial-intelligence frenzy that has powered the equity bull market might be overblown.
